title: MTF-1 data and final closure
purpose: Build and prove canonical multi-timeframe data authority, then bind local and Owner external evidence into final MTF-1 closure.
entry_condition: Owner starts MTF-1 closure or an individual MTF-1 evidence stage on the exact candidate.

transitions.action: Resolve canonical Python environment and shared closure_run_id
Collect/verify native broker MTF, DQ, alignment, lineage and terminal root
Compile exact canonical EA and verify semantic log + fresh EX5 + tool/source provenance
Bind all stages to one closure_run_id and verify existing evidence read-only

invariants: M5 is canonical value authority; M15/H1/H4 are deterministic derivations.
No stage may mix evidence from different closure_run_id or source-tree signature.
Local 75/75 alone is insufficient for MTF-1 closure.
Mutable open boundary bars are separated from immutable closed history.
failure_behavior: Any identity, parity, causality, data-quality, compile, or evidence mismatch fails closed.
Missing external evidence remains NOT_PROVEN; it is never inferred from source tests.
restart_behavior: A new closure attempt receives a new shared closure_run_id; prior evidence remains immutable.
rollback_behavior: No source/runtime authority is promoted by a failed closure; accepted source remains unchanged.
